langejan.name: Lange Jan
langejan.slogan: Zeeland's tallest tower, rising straight out of the abbey.
langejan.line: At 90.4 metres, the abbey tower can be climbed up its 207 steps to roughly the halfway point.

watersnoodmuseum.name: Watersnoodmuseum
watersnoodmuseum.slogan: Walk inside the concrete giants that shut the sea out.
watersnoodmuseum.line: Four wartime Phoenix caissons were sunk at Ouwerkerk in November 1953 to close the last gap in the dike; they now house the museum.

zierikzeetoren.name: Dikke Toren
zierikzeetoren.slogan: Half a giant, and proud of it, since 1510.
zierikzeetoren.line: Building began in 1454 for a spire of about 130 metres, but money ran out and it stopped at 62.

schotsehuizen.name: Scottish Houses
schotsehuizen.slogan: Gothic gables where Scottish wool once changed hands.
schotsehuizen.line: Veere was the staple port for Scotland from 1541 to 1799, and these two quayside houses were built for Scottish wool merchants.

zeeuwsmuseum.name: Zeeuws Museum
zeeuwsmuseum.slogan: Zeeland's lace, caps and tapestries inside the old abbey.
zeeuwsmuseum.line: The museum has occupied the Middelburg abbey since 20 June 1972 and holds the famous Zeeland tapestries and regional costume.
